reviews.text:
I truly regret getting my braces done here just because of the cheap price. I had my braces done here and the alignment was not done properly, but I was too young at the time to realise something was wrong. My upper teeth ended up with several gaps, while my lower teeth were overly tight. Everything seemed fine initially, but a few years after completing the braces treatment, my lower teeth started turning black. I eventually had to undergo root canal treatment, and the dentist told me it was likely caused by the braces being done improperly.

Guys, please be aware and never get your braces done here just because it’s cheap.

She gave very good advice for his tooth care and routine.
For myself, the scaling and polish treatment went smoothly and Dr Mazlina took her time to do a thorough job.
Also to mention, there is a clean and peaceful surau if you need to use the facilities.
Thanks Iman Dentalcare
We will surely visit again.

I am Highly Dissatisfied and Frustrated with my experience.

I visited for a routine replacement of an old front tooth filling that had degraded over time. Unfortunately, Dr BEATRIX had to redo the filling twice during my first visit because the initial result was unacceptable. The first filling was an Obvious color mismatch. Although the second attempt was an improvement, part of the filling still did not match the color of my natural tooth.

As a result, I had to return for a third procedure to have it redone again. During this visit, Dr. Beatrix suggested that I Pay Extra for a “better grade” filling material.

My main concern is why this option was not recommended from the beginning. If a higher-grade filling was necessary to achieve a proper color match, I should have been informed before the first procedure so that I could make an informed decision. Instead, I had to undergo the same treatment three times, wasting my time and causing unnecessary discomfort.

For what should have been a straightforward filling replacement, the overall experience was disappointing. I expected better communication, proper treatment planning, and a satisfactory result without having to undergo the same procedure three times.

P/s: Receptionist was very kind and patience arranging my appointments and listening to my concern. The star goes to the front desk team.

The extraction was done quickly, although the consultation was brief, possibly because I already had a report from another clinic, I still felt well cared for. I booked my appointment through MySejahtera about month ago, late but still manageble.

What truly stood out to me was the kindness of the staff. At that time, my work contract had ended, n I did not have access to a debit card, only cash. Since payment had to be made by card n she kindly used her own card and trusted me to repay her in cash. That gesture meant a lot to me.

Later that same day, I experienced some issues, n I was very touched that both the nurse and doctor waited for me to return n checked on my condition again, as my tooth was still bleeding. Their patience n care made me feel safe n supported as pregnant mom 😭

Thanks alot for your kindness n dedication. I truly appreciate the compassionate service here. Not all government clinics provide this kind level of care. Even a next their KKIA feels slower n less organised, n sometimes I dont feel supported 😅

reviews.text:
before someone comes here saying i’m being too sensitive or dramatic, no 😭 i’m not the only person they were rude to. i literally saw them talking to other people with the same rude tone and attitude too. so clearly it’s not just me “being sensitive”. so basically i forgot to bring my ic because i wanted to book a mysejahtera appointment, and apparently they needed my ic for confirmation. i know that was MY mistake, and i fully acknowledge that i should’ve brought it. i also forgot my credit card, okay, my bad 😭 but the way the counter staff talked to me was completely unnecessary.

you can literally tell me “you need your ic for confirmation, unfortunately we can’t proceed without it” and i would understand. there was absolutely no need for the rude tone, making faces, rolling your eyes, or talking to me like i’m a toddler. i already know i made a mistake 😭 you don’t have to embarrass me in front of everyone else just to make your point.

what pissed me off more was the way you were talking to me with other people standing around, as if i was stupid for forgetting my own ic. i’m a grown adult, i understand the procedure. i don’t need to be lectured or spoken down to just because i made one small mistake.

being professional doesn’t mean you have to be overly nice, but at least have basic respect and courtesy when dealing with customers. you can enforce the rules without making someone feel humiliated. your job is to explain the procedure, not make people feel stupid for not knowing or forgetting something.

i genuinely would’ve accepted the mistake and just gone home if you had explained it properly. it was your attitude that made the whole situation unnecessarily uncomfortable. please learn the difference between correcting someone and being condescending to them.

you’re lucky i didn’t catch your name because otherwise i would’ve mentioned it here. i’m not gonna sit here and act like your attitude was okay just because i made a small mistake. i can admit when i’m wrong, but that doesn’t mean you get to disrespect me over it.

reviews.text:
Semalam sampai kat Klink Kesihatan Kajang, bahagian Klinik Pergigian Kajang pada pukul 8:30 am.

Sebab I ni walk in appointment, kena isi form kat kaunter pendaftaran dulu.

Lepas tu, tunggu lebih kurang 10 minit, seorang doktor perempuan Cina muda panggil nama saya untuk buat medical check up.

Masa check up, dia tanya tentang soalan lazim. Lepas tu, I cakap saya ni TB carrier, baru aje habiskan 3 month treatment.

Lepas dia dgn rakan setugas dengar tu, mereka mencadangkan letak saya kat batch terakhir sekali, pukul 12:15 pm ponya slot.

I paham & setuju, pergi buat urusan & datang balik pada pukul 12:10 pm.

Doktor panggil nombor saya pada pukul 12:40 pm, dia check saya & mendapati ade beberapa gigi yg dah rosak teruk.

Sebab teramat sakit ni, doktor bagi ubat amoxicilin & paracetamol utk tahan sakit dulu.

Next appointmennt utk cabut gigi pada 12hb Mac 11:45 am, harap2 dpt menyelesaikan masalah gigi rosak I ni secepat mungkin.

PS: Ribuan terima kasih kepada semua doktor2, nurse2 & staff2 kat Klinik Pergigian Kajang, korang ponya service memang terbaik!

reviews.text: I went in for bleeding gums and got a filling, scaling, and polishing done. The clinic is bright, clean, and comfortable, and Dr. Darshen took the time to understand my concerns, explained my condition clearly, and advised on the best course of treatment. You can tell he genuinely cares about his patients and knows what he’s doing. I highly recommend his services! 😊🦷

reviews.name: saif hisham
reviews.text:
I had scaling done today at Klinik Pergigian Dr.D & it was honestly one of the best dental experiences I’ve ever had.

Dr. Darshan was extremely detailed & thorough during the scaling. I could really feel the care & precision throughout the treatment. Not only that, he took the time to show me photos of my teeth, explained my condition clearly, & patiently taught me the correct way to brush my teeth. I also received very helpful tips, including recommendations to use an ultra soft toothbrush & improve my oral care routine.

This was more than just a scaling session — it felt like a proper dental education & treatment at the same time. I’ve been to other dental clinics before, but I’ve never received this level of attention & detail.

Very satisfied & genuinely happy with the service. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: MOHAMMAD ASYRAF MOHD TAJUDIN
reviews.text: Outstanding service from Dr. Darshen and the team! I visited for the first time on Malam Raya, and even though the clinic was closing at 8:30 PM, doctor still took the time to see me for a last-minute consultation. The care I received was superb, and the prices are very affordable. I’ve already done my wisdom tooth surgery today. I’ll definitely be recommending this place to all my family and friends. Thanks Dr and Selamat Hari Raya.

reviews.name: Rupini Chandran
reviews.text:
I had a great experience at Dr D for my clear aligner treatment over the past year. From the very beginning, Dr Darshen was patient, thorough, and took the time to clearly explain the entire process, which really put me at ease.

Throughout the 1-year journey, he was attentive and ensured everything was progressing as planned. I really appreciated how responsive and reassuring he was whenever I had questions or concerns.

The results have been amazing — my teeth look so much better, and the whole process was much smoother than I expected. I’d definitely recommend Dr Darshen and the team at Dr D to anyone considering clear aligners or looking for a dentist who genuinely cares about their patients.

reviews.name: Jer3myx T.
reviews.text:
RM50 - Dentist Consultation | From RM180 - Tooth Filling

I was on the hunt for a dentist specializing in gums, a periodontist. After checking a few clinics nearby, this place replied that while they don’t have a specialist, Dr Adrian handles periodontal management and oral prophylaxis for most patients. Figured I’d give it a shot.

Finding the clinic wasn’t too tricky, even though it’s tucked away a bit. Parking is a little painful though—RM4.00 per hour—but at least it’s on the ground floor, so you can’t miss it.

I visited on a weekend, and the area was surprisingly quiet. Just Dr Adrian and the front counter staff holding the fort. Felt almost private, like the clinic was reserved just for me.

When my turn came, I explained why I was there, and Dr Adrian responded professionally, answering all my questions clearly. I was a bit surprised he did the whole checkup and tooth filling solo, no nurse in sight. Still, everything was thorough, proper, and efficient.

The fees felt a touch on the higher side—consultation at RM50 and fillings starting RM180—but I left satisfied. Dr Adrian delivered exactly what I needed, and the clinic has definitely earned a spot on my revisit list.

reviews.name: Melvin Lim
reviews.text:
Outstanding Experience at Elements Dental Clinic!

I had my teeth cleaning and an extraction done today at Elements Dental Clinic, and I’m genuinely impressed with the level of care and professionalism I received.

Dr. Adrian was incredibly gentle, patient, and reassuring throughout the entire procedure. He explained each step clearly and always checked to make sure I was comfortable, which really helped calm my nerves.

A special shoutout to his assistant, Cik Alia, who was warm, attentive, and supportive from the moment I walked into the treatment room. Both of them made a fantastic team, their coordination and care made the whole experience smooth and stress-free.

The clinic itself is clean, modern, and has a welcoming atmosphere that instantly puts you at ease. From the front desk to the treatment chair, everything was handled with professionalism and genuine care.

I’m truly satisfied with my visit. If you’re looking for a trustworthy dental clinic with skilled practitioners and friendly service, I highly recommend Elements Dental Clinic.
Thank you Dr. Adrian and Cik Alia for taking such amazing care of me today!

Very disappointing experience. This clinic advertised scaling and polishing for RM79, but after I arrived, the dentist convinced me to pay RM250 by promising additional treatment and benefits. I agreed because I trusted the dentist's explanation.
During the appointment, I believe only scaling was performed. When I asked about polishing, I was told it had already been done, even though I did not experience what is commonly understood as the polishing step. reviews.text:
Alhamdulillah, this was my first visit here.

Because I have experienced panic attacks during dental scaling and teeth whitening in the past, I was very careful when choosing a dental clinic. After searching for quite some time, I finally found My Fave Clinic.

The scaling and whitening services exceeded my expectations. The entire team at Tiara and Dr. Amir were incredibly kind, patient, and reassuring throughout the treatment. They took the time to help me stay calm and comfortable.

Alhamdulillah, I didn’t experience a panic attack during my appointment yesterday, which meant so much to me.

Thank you, Dr. Amir and the entire team. I truly appreciate your professionalism, compassion, and excellent care. Highly recommended for anyone who feels anxious about visiting the dentist.

reviews.name: Aliessa
reviews.text:
I’ve been coming to this clinic since I was a student and even now that I’m working, I still choose to come here. The quality of care has always been consistent and I’ve never been disappointed. Dr Haziqah and Dr Amir are both friendly, attentive and knowledgeable. They always take the time to explain each treatment clearly and make sure I’m comfortable throughout the visit. I even had two wisdom teeth extracted at the same time here. The procedure was smooth and my recovery was much better than I expected with very minimal discomfort.

The clinic itself is also beautiful, clean and has such a calm and relaxing atmosphere which makes every visit a pleasant experience.

reviews.name: Seribayu
reviews.text: I think this is the first time I've actually enjoyed a dentist visit (besides the day I finally got my braces removed 13 years ago, haha!). The clinic assistants were super helpful and the doctor was meticulous. I came in for scaling, polishing, and whitening. I was bracing myself for a slightly painful scaling experience since it had been a while for me, but surprisingly, I was comfortable the whole time! The doctor kept thanking me for being patient, but honestly, I've got to thank him for a mostly pain-free procedure. Pricing is reasonable, and frankly, I don't mind paying if the experience is this good. I'll definitely be back to redo my composite veneers and whitening. Thank you, Dr. Amir and team!

reviews.text:
Saya mengalami masalah gigi geraham yang pecah dan bahagian yang tajam sehingga menyebabkan ketidakselesaan. Kebetulan saya terjumpa Klinik Pergigian Tiara Dental dan membuat keputusan untuk mendapatkan rawatan di sini.
Sejurus melangkah masuk ke klinik, saya rasa seperti berada di dalam spa. Suasana klinik sangat bersih, kemas, selesa dan berbau harum, membuatkan saya rasa tenang walaupun datang dalam keadaan kurang selesa akibat sakit gigi.

Staf di kaunter juga sangat baik, mesra dan membantu. Mereka melayan pelanggan dengan sopan serta membuatkan proses pendaftaran berjalan dengan lancar.

Terima kasih yang tidak terhingga kepada Dr. Amir yang merawat saya. Beliau sangat baik, peramah dan profesional. Penerangan yang diberikan mengenai keadaan gigi saya sangat jelas dan mudah difahami. Dr. Amir juga sabar menjawab pertanyaan saya dan memastikan saya selesa sepanjang rawatan dijalankan.

Pengalaman yang sangat memuaskan dan saya amat mengesyorkan Klinik Pergigian Tiara Dental kepada sesiapa yang mencari klinik pergigian dengan perkhidmatan yang berkualiti, suasana yang menenangkan dan doktor yang berpengalaman. Terima kasih Tiara Dental dan Dr. Amir! 😊🦷✨

reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Memang sangat-sangat puas hati dengan Klinik Pergigian Balqis! Dari mula sampai sekarang, memang tak pernah rasa kecewa. Klinik pun cantik, bersih, selesa dan suasana dia memang buat kita rasa tenang bila datang. Semua staff sangat friendly, peramah dan layanan memang tip top. Tak kira masa datang untuk appointment atau buat review, semua dilayan dengan baik dan sangat professional.

Doctor pun memang terbaik! Baik, friendly, lembut dan yang paling penting sangat-sangat membantu. Apa-apa yang kita tak faham, doctor akan explain dengan jelas sampai kita betul-betul faham. Tak rasa takut atau nervous pun nak buat rawatan sebab cara doctor layan patient memang sangat bagus.

Saya sendiri buat braces dekat sini dan setakat ni memang sangat berpuas hati. Setiap bulan datang untuk review pun semuanya berjalan dengan lancar. Staff akan check dengan teliti, doctor pun akan explain progress dan apa yang perlu dibuat seterusnya. Memang rasa berbaloi pilih Klinik Pergigian Balqis untuk rawatan braces.

Paling saya suka, layanan dari first appointment sampai sekarang memang konsisten. Bukan masa mula-mula sahaja baik, setiap kali datang tetap dapat layanan yang sama—mesra, professional dan sangat membantu. Memang boleh nampak semua staff buat kerja dengan ikhlas dan bersungguh-sungguh.

Kalau ada yang tengah survey klinik gigi atau tengah fikir nak buat braces, memang saya sangat recommend Klinik Pergigian Balqis. Klinik cantik, staff bagus, doctor terbaik, layanan tip top dan rawatan pun memang memuaskan. Setakat pengalaman saya sepanjang buat braces dekat sini, memang 10/10! ❤️🦷

Terima kasih Klinik Pergigian Balqis sebab sentiasa bagi service yang terbaik. Harap terus maintain kualiti dan layanan macam ni! Memang puas hati dan tak menyesal pilih klinik ni. 🥰✨

reviews.name: Queen S
reviews.text:
After going through a very difficult tooth extraction at another dental clinic three weeks ago, I was left with constant pain in my jaw, under my throat, and even my chest. The pain was so severe that I suspected another problematic tooth might be contributing to it, so I decided to visit Dental Home.

Before my appointment, I briefly explained my condition to the front desk via WhatsApp. I was genuinely impressed by how attentive and caring they were. They even informed their founder about my situation so that extra attention could be given to my case.

Dr. Shaun is not only highly experienced but also incredibly thorough and compassionate. Instead of focusing solely on extracting my tooth, he took the time to investigate why I had been suffering such intense pain for three weeks after my previous extraction. He carefully examined my condition, reviewed my dental history, and even consulted my GP regarding my medical history to better understand the possible cause. That level of dedication and professionalism is something I have rarely experienced.

After receiving treatment at Dental Home, I finally felt relieved and reassured. Coming here after such a traumatic experience at another clinic felt like meeting a team of angels when I needed them the most. Every member of the staff showed genuine care, kindness, and professionalism throughout my visit.

Dental Home has completely restored my confidence in dental care. Without a doubt, this will be the only dental clinic I will be visiting in the future.

reviews.text: I recently brought my son for his yearly checkup at Klinik Gigi Hasmuni, and I cannot thank Dr. Thanuja enough for her outstanding care. Handling a toddler during a dental exam is no easy feat, but Dr. Thanuja managed the entire session with incredible patience, warmth, and calm. Despite the challenges of treating a young child, she remained highly professional throughout and successfully completed all the necessary checks. It is rare to find a doctor who balances top-tier professional skill with such genuine empathy. Thank you, Dr. Thanuja, for making what could have been a stressful visit such a positive experience!

reviews.name: Revati Krishnathasan
reviews.text:
We had a very pleasant experience bringing our 3-year-old for a dental appointment here. From the moment we arrived, the clinic felt clean, spacious, and welcoming. There was a nice play area with toys which really helped keep our toddler relaxed and distracted while waiting. The environment felt very child-friendly and comfortable, which made a big difference for us as parents.

Dr. Thanujaa was extremely calm, patient, and gentle throughout the entire appointment. They took the time to talk to our toddler, build trust, and never rushed the process even when our child was being shy and uncooperative at times. You can really tell they are experienced with young children and understand how to handle toddlers in a caring and reassuring way.

The staff were also friendly, polite, and helpful from start to finish. Overall, the whole experience was smooth and much less stressful than we expected for a toddler’s dental visit. We truly appreciated the kindness, professionalism, and patience shown by the team. Highly recommended for parents looking for a clean, comfortable, and toddler-friendly dental clinic.

I had the joy of having Dr. Ain take over my root canal treatment and crown after my pulpectomy in Singapore, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience.

From the very first visit, Dr. Ain was incredibly gentle, patient, and reassuring. She took the time to explain every step of the process, turning what initially felt like fear and uncertainty into a comfortable, well-informed journey. Over the course of three visits, I always felt I was in capable and caring hands.

What I expected to be a stressful dental experience became surprisingly pleasant. It even gave me a good excuse to visit Kuala Lumpur regularly—it felt like a little dental holiday each time!

Thank you, Dr. Ain, for your professionalism, kindness, and excellent care. I would gladly recommend her to anyone looking for a dentist who combines expertise with genuine compassion.

reviews.name: Lyn K
reviews.text:
Best dental experience for my daughters and me!

I used to dread going to the dentist because the experience was often uncomfortable—especially when the tools were used and sometimes I would even see blood when rinsing. But Dr Ain completely changed that. She was so gentle during scaling and made the whole process pleasant and stress-free.

Both my 2-year-old and 7-year-old daughters enjoyed their visit too. Dr Ain was very patient with them—she answered my 7-year-old’s curious questions and even shared fun stories that made her feel at ease. She enjoyed it so much she said she wants to go again!

My 2-year-old was cautious at first, but Dr Ain and her nurse gently coaxed her, and by the end of it she was happy and even pretended to be a dentist when we got home—that’s how much she enjoyed the experience!

The clinic itself is very clean, comfortable, and family-friendly with a cozy reading corner and toys to keep kids entertained.

Truly a highly recommended clinic for both adults and children. ⭐️

reviews.text:
Honest review from a former patient who completed 4 years of braces treatment at this clinic.

While I appreciate the time and effort put into my treatment, I unfortunately cannot recommend this clinic for braces.

Throughout the treatment, I found the approach to be rather rough and explanations regarding my dental progress were often minimal. Some aspects of the treatment felt rushed or careless for example, rubber bands were occasionally not installed properly, and bands or brackets would come off just days after being installed.

Additionally, I felt disappointed by how my concerns were addressed during monthly check-ups. Some of my questions were dismissed without proper explanation, which left me feeling unheard as a patient.

Unfortunately, the final results of the braces did not meet my expectations. For those considering braces, I would recommend seeking treatment from a specialised orthodontic clinic for better care and communication. Thank you.

reviews.text:
Kinda wish that doc explain betul2 apa jadi dengan gigi saya sebelum buat tampalan.

Buat tampalan dkt sini bulan 1. Tapi lepas tampalan rasa sakit bila pakai retainer. Doc suruh tahan dlm 2 minggu. Tapi tak tahan sangat so saya mintala 2nd opinion. 2nd Doc tu ckp tampalan tak cukup. So dia tampal balik tapi lepas tampal takleh floss. So esoknya pegi balik adjust tampalan.

Sebulan lepas tu saya rasa nyilu. Pegi klinik ni balik sbb bad experience previously. Doc tu cakap gigi saya fractured. Doc tu terus tampalan tanpa bagitau fractured tu besar or how much my teeth impacted. Lepas tampalan tu doc ckp kat saya gigi saya tinggal separuh. Saya mcm terkejut. Kenapa ckp benda tu lepas tampalan. Tapi lepas tampalan tu gigi saya ok for few months.

Bulan 6 rasa nyilu balik so pegi balik klinik ni balik. Doc buat tampalan balik. Lepas seminggu still rasa nyilu so doc recommend root canal or refer endo. Tapi bila recommend root canal, doc mcm tak explain kenapa kena buat root canal semua tu dekat gigi saya. Saya rasa masa tu gaya doc mcm terburu2 or nak settle keje cepat

Saya tak sure kenapa gigi saya makin teruk lps tampalan tu. Mungkin doc ni buat silap? Tak sure la sbb saya tak boleh nampak gigi belakang saya tu. Tak sure nak bagi rating rendah or tinggi sbb rasa doc ni mungkin cuba yg terbaik cuma kena improve la communication tu. Every surgery even minor one need full explanation so patient tau apa yang dibuat ke gigi tu. So saya bagi rating tengah2 je la

reviews.text:
My wife brought our son to this dental clinic because he was suffering from severe toothache and tooth decay. From the moment they arrived, the dentist immediately recognised that he was autistic and approached him with incredible patience, kindness, and understanding.

Our son is extremely afraid of dentists and injections, so we were expecting the visit to be very challenging. However, thanks to the dentist's gentle, warm, and reassuring approach, he cooperated much better than we ever imagined. She was able to extract his tooth and complete multiple fillings with very little struggle.

What touched us the most was how calm and compassionate she was throughout the entire treatment. She never rushed, never became agitated, and took all the time needed to make our son feel comfortable and safe.

As parents, it means so much to find a dentist who genuinely cares for children with special needs. She is truly a gem, and we are incredibly grateful for the exceptional care she gave our son. We highly recommend this clinic, especially to parents of children with special needs.I hope this review helps other parents who may be anxious about finding the right dentist for their child.

I’m very grateful to have found Dr Mah after having a very bad experience with my previous dentist. My braces treatment failed badly, and several other dentists told me that I would need to remove multiple teeth and get expensive dental implants done from scratch.

Thankfully, Dr Mah was honest, experienced, and confident enough to try saving my original teeth instead of pushing for unnecessary extra procedures. After more than two years of treatment, he successfully fixed my teeth without needing implants or extractions. I truly appreciate his professionalism, responsibility, and dedication to his patients. He always explains everything clearly and patiently, which gave me a lot of confidence throughout the process.

Dr Jessica is also excellent. She is very professional, attentive, and gentle during dental cleaning and regular treatments, making every visit comfortable and stress-free.

I now continue going to this clinic for all my dental checkup because I completely trust their care and expertise. Highly recommended to anyone looking for an experienced, caring, and trustworthy dental team!
